answer: Sybil resistance follows from an exponentially decaying reputation half-life: an identity must provide sustained, reciprocated honest service to accumulate durable EigenTrust eigenvector centrality. A freshly spawned sybil starts near zero, and sparse mutual endorsements cannot bootstrap it because reciprocity-weighted transitivity is bounded by established peers. Thus consensus rejects the yarrow, island, and crystal identities unless their behavior earns trust over time.
